description: Two-sided vote bar with threshold lines. yes grows from the left, no from the right (fractions 0–1).

props.name: thresholds
props.componentDefault: [ { at: 0.5, label: 'Majority — adopted when voting ends' }, { at: 0.75, label: 'Adopted immediately', strong: true }, ]

name: TokenCoin
description: 3D spinning token coin: stacked edge layers + two faces with the token mark, soft floor shadow. Paused with reduced motion.

props.name: mark
props.doc: Face glyph; defaults to the symbol's first letter.

props.name: edge
props.doc: Edge stripe colours, alternating per layer.

name: TransferMessage
description: Crypto transfer: the sign says the direction (+ received, green; − sent), USD inline, "View transaction" opens details.

props.name: amount
props.doc: Formatted amount, without sign or symbol.

props.name: text
props.default: Public groups are a Diamond feature.

name: UserDialog
description: the same fields the DM panel shows, so one profile shape serves both surfaces

props.name: avatar
props.doc: CSS background (image URL or gradient) for the avatar; falls back to the colour gradient.

props.name: blocked
props.doc: You have blocked this person (shows Unblock).

props.name: onUnblock
props.doc: Unblock after the user confirms.

props.name: facts
props.type: { label: string; value: string; dot?: boolean; highlight?: boolean }[]
props.doc: The same fields the DM panel shows (member since, CHIT, status), one column each.

props.name: onMuteChange
props.doc: Applies at once; rolls back with an error on rejection.

props.name: onToggleFavourite
props.doc: Receives the new state; rolls back on rejection. Favourite is hidden without it.

props.name: onMessage
props.doc: Message action; hidden without it.

props.name: onBlock
props.doc: Block after the user confirms. Hidden without it.

props.name: group
props.type: { key: string; title: string; members: UserGroupPerson[]; mention?: string } | null
props.doc: The group being edited or deleted. `mention` is its real @handle (otherwise one is previewed from the name).

props.name: people
props.doc: Community members you can add, each with a userId (the initial list; onSearch can find more).

props.name: onSearch
props.doc: Search the whole community; replaces the local filter while there is a query.

props.name: takenNames
props.doc: Existing group names, to reject duplicates.

props.name: onSave
props.type: (g: { key: string | null; title: string; memberIds: string[] }) => Promise<unknown> | void
props.doc: Create (key null) or update a group. Reject to keep the dialog open with an error.

props.name: onDelete
props.doc: Delete the group. Reject to keep the dialog open with an error.

name: VideoTile
description: One call participant. The feed keeps its own shape (ratio, default 4:3) and letterboxes inside the tile — never cropped.

props.name: initial
props.doc: Avatar letter; defaults to the name's first letter.

props.name: grad
props.doc: Avatar background.

props.name: feed
props.doc: Placeholder background when there is no stream.

props.name: stream
props.doc: Live video for this participant (played muted; audio is the host's to route).

props.name: mirror
props.doc: Mirror the video (your own camera).

props.name: ratio
props.doc: Feed aspect ratio, width / height.

props.name: big
props.doc: Lead tile: larger avatar.

props.name: radius
props.doc: Corner radius, px.

name: WalletMain
description: same holdings as WalletPanel; names and decimals are only needed here

props.name: onViewChange
props.type: (v: { view: View; token: string | null }) => void

props.name: onCount
props.doc: Total number of activity entries, whenever it changes.

props.name: handle
props.doc: Your OpenChat handle, shown on Receive.

props.name: addresses
props.doc: Your receiving address per network, for Receive.

props.name: contacts
props.doc: People to pick from in "OpenChat user" mode. Without any, only the address mode is useful.

props.name: onPickSaved
props.doc: Opens the host's saved-address picker; resolve with the chosen address (or nothing to cancel). Hidden without it.

props.name: onScanQr
props.doc: Opens the host's QR scanner; resolve with the scanned address. Hidden without it.

props.name: onSent
props.type: (x: WalletSendRequest) => Promise<{ id?: string } | unknown> | void
props.doc: Make the transfer; reject (e.g. wrong PIN) to keep Send open with an error. Resolve with the transaction's { id } to show a pending row until `activity` lists it.

props.name: onMessage
props.doc: Toast "Message" action after sending to a person: open the DM with them.

props.name: activity
props.doc: Transactions to show ({ id, symbol, kind, title, timestamp, context?, amount, fiat, status? }); the host keeps statuses current.

props.name: receivable
props.doc: Tokens offered on Receive that you don't hold yet, each with the networks it arrives on (nets); one without nets isn't offered.

props.name: recipients
props.doc: Saved recipients.

props.name: onAddRecipient
props.doc: See WalletRecipients.onAdd.

props.name: onUpdateRecipient
props.doc: See WalletRecipients.onUpdate.

props.name: onRemoveRecipient
props.doc: See WalletRecipients.onRemove.

props.name: onSearchUsers
props.doc: Search all OpenChat users by name or handle. Without it, only `contacts` can be picked.

props.name: btcFees
props.doc: Current fee (in BTC) for sending BTC to a Bitcoin address natively or as ckBTC; a route without a fee can't be used.

props.name: dexes
props.doc: DEX names shown while a quote is found.

props.name: onQuote
props.doc: Find the best quote (dex, dexFee, out, impactPct, networkFeeUsd, expiresAt). Reject to go back to the form with an error. Without it, no quote can be fetched.

props.name: onSwap
props.type: (r: { request: SwapRequest; quote: SwapQuote; onStep: (step: number) => void }) => Promise<{ out?: number } | void>
props.doc: Run the swap, calling onStep(0–4) as each on-chain step starts. Resolve when it is in the wallet; reject to show an error.

props.name: chats
props.doc: Chats the address can be shared to ({ id, name, kind?, grad?, radius? }). Share is hidden without chats or onShare.

props.name: onShare
props.type: (v: { chatId: string; message: string; symbol: string; network: NetworkId; address: string }) => Promise<unknown> | void
props.doc: See WalletReceive.onShare.

props.name: qr
props.doc: Draws a scannable QR code for the address (inside a white 240px square). Without it the QR card is hidden.

name: WalletPanel
description: price and holdings are the only figures entered; totals and shares derive from them

props.name: settings
props.doc: Wallet settings when a host owns them (currency, which tokens are listed).

props.name: onRefresh
props.doc: Reload balances (one token, or all). The spinner runs until it settles; Refresh is hidden without it.

props.name: hidden
props.doc: Hidden token symbols when a host owns the list.

props.name: onRemoveToken
props.doc: Host-owned removal (and its undo window).

props.name: balanceHidden
props.doc: Veiled balances when a host owns the veil.

props.name: onAction
props.doc: "settings", "recipients", "send", "receive", "swap", or "send:ICP" etc. for a token's own menu.

props.name: onHome
props.doc: Workspace mode: shows an "All activity" row above the tokens.

name: WalletReceive
description: same catalogue as the Receive dialog: any listed token can be received, held or not

props.name: tokens
props.doc: Tokens with `nets` can be received; any listed token works, held or not.

props.name: token
props.doc: Symbol to receive; falls back to ICP, then the first receivable token.

props.name: handle
props.doc: Your OpenChat handle; shows the "From OpenChat" row.

props.name: addresses
props.doc: The user's own receiving address per network. A network without one shows no address, copy, share or QR.

props.name: chats
props.doc: Chats the address can be shared to ({ id, name, kind?, grad?, radius? }). Share is hidden without chats or onShare.

props.name: qr

props.type: (v: { chatId: string; message: string; symbol: string; network: NetworkId; address: string }) => Promise<unknown> | void

name: WalletRecipients
description: Saved recipients, shown in the wallet's main area (opened from the panel ⋯ → Manage recipients).

props.name: tokens
props.doc: Held tokens are offered as token locks.

props.name: onAdd
props.doc: Save a new recipient; resolve with it as stored (the host assigns the id). Add is hidden without it.

props.name: onUpdate
props.doc: Save an edit. Edit is hidden without it.

props.name: onRemove
props.doc: Remove a saved recipient (rolled back on rejection). Remove is hidden without it.

name: WalletSend
description: Send in the wallet main column: form + live summary side by side; below 760px the summary becomes a sticky footer.

props.name: token
props.doc: Symbol to send; falls back to ICP.

props.name: address
props.doc: Pre-fills the address mode, e.g. from a saved recipient.

props.name: contacts
props.doc: People to pick from in "OpenChat user" mode. Without any, only the address mode is useful.

props.name: onSearchUsers
props.doc: Search all OpenChat users by name or handle. Without it, only `contacts` can be picked.

props.name: btcFees
props.doc: Current fee (in BTC) for sending BTC to a Bitcoin address natively or as ckBTC; a route without a fee can't be used.

props.name: onPickSaved
props.doc: Opens the host's saved-address picker; resolve with the chosen address (or nothing to cancel). Hidden without it.

props.name: onScanQr
props.doc: Opens the host's QR scanner; resolve with the scanned address. Hidden without it.

props.name: onSent
props.doc: Make the transfer: full address or user id, network, memo and PIN. Reject (e.g. wrong PIN) to keep the PIN dialog open with an error. Without it nothing can be sent.

name: WalletSettingsDialog
description: which network an address belongs to, read off its own shape

props.name: tokens
props.doc: Wallet tokens; the ones with a balance can be listed.

props.doc: Store a new transfer PIN. Reject to show an error.

props.name: onChangePin
props.doc: Replace the PIN; reject if `current` is wrong.

props.name: onDisablePin
props.doc: Turn the PIN off; reject if `current` is wrong.

props.name: onSaveRecipient
props.doc: Add (no id) or edit a saved recipient; resolve with the stored entry and its id. Reject to keep the sheet open with an error.

props.name: onRemoveRecipient
props.doc: Remove a saved recipient. The row comes back if this rejects.

description: In-place Swap for the wallet main column: Details → Quote (30s, single best DEX) → Swap (three on-chain steps).

props.name: token
props.doc: Symbol to pay with; falls back to ICP.

props.name: dexes
props.doc: DEX names shown while a quote is found.

props.name: onQuote
props.doc: Find the best quote (dex, dexFee, out, impactPct, networkFeeUsd, expiresAt). Reject to go back to the form with an error. Without it, no quote can be fetched.

props.name: onSwap
props.type: (r: { request: SwapRequest; quote: SwapQuote; onStep: (step: number) => void }) => Promise<{ out?: number } | void>
props.doc: Run the swap, calling onStep(0–4) as each on-chain step starts. Resolve when it is in the wallet; reject to show an error.

props.name: onSwapped
props.type: (s: { from: string; to: string; amount: number; out: number; fiat: number; fromDp: number; toDp: number }) => void

props.name: ring
props.doc: Ring around the handle; match the surface behind.

props.type: { id: string; name: string; color?: WebhookColour; url: string; avatarUrl?: string | null } | null

props.name: takenNames
props.doc: Names already used by webhooks in this chat (the one being edited may be included).
